new.rationale: Of 53 games profiled on 2026-11-07, eight used an hourglass NOW/2 HOURS icon (+1 Anime Eyes, Create A Disaster, Punch Out Of Prison, +1 Money Per Click, MORPH WORLD, Hike For Eggs, Destroy The Sun, Garden Tower Defense), all of them update-heavy games. Confirm if games showing the icon gain Top Trending or Up-and-Coming places on the following day more often than their peers; refute if their next-day moves match the rest (today +1 Anime Eyes fell 22 on Up-and-Coming while showing it).

qualitative_updates.note: The ragdoll wave widened: Ragdoll Physics (26 days) and Ragdoll Research (10 days, +42) sit #2 and #3 on Up-and-Coming, Ragdoll Physics entered Most Popular, and Ragdoll Playground rose 9 on Most Popular; 'Ragdoll' is now 10% of Up-and-Coming titles (r=+0.31).
DONT SPLASH (21 days) fell off Top Trending but stays among the leaders on Most Popular and #4 on Up-and-Coming, and the newer DONT SWIM (13 days) climbed 33 on Top Trending.

Mixed day: +1 Venom Evolution [🎃] fell off Top Trending and Up-and-Coming, Grow a Chicken Fighter [🎃] and Steal A Pet And Ride It [🎃] fell off, and Candy Kingdom Defense fell 69 on Top Earning; but a dusty trip [🎃HALLOWEEN] rose 7 on Most Popular and King Legacy [UPD 11 🎃] entered Top Trending with a fresh update. Held at 45%.

Clones kept falling (Fake an Egg -10 Most Popular, Farm Evolution -25 Top Trending, Raise A Catboy -22 Up-and-Coming) while Steal An Egg still tops Most Popular; Steal Eggs From Tsunami (+30 Top Trending) is the exception.
